findings.label: Enrollment bypass in findDetail
findings.description: CoursesService.findDetail generates presigned URLs for all topics unconditionally, then checks enrollment afterward. A non-enrolled student receives fully playable signed video and material URLs. Move the enrollment check before URL signing, or strip URL fields when isEnrolled is false.

findings.label: findMine implicit coupling
findings.description: findMine returns course rows with no topic include, so no URLs leak today. If a topics include is added later, stored S3 URLs would appear unsigned and 403. Add a comment warning that any future topics include must pass through generatePresignedGetUrl.
